title: The Terminal
tagline: Stuck at JFK, nine months and counting.
about: A traveller from Krakozhia is stranded at JFK when his country falls to a coup mid-flight, and makes a life inside the terminal.

Potato and cheese dumplings with sour cream and onions.How to make it300g plain flour1 egg150ml warm water400g floury potatoes, boiled and mashed100g cheddar, grated2 brown onions, thinly sliced50g butter200g sour cream2 tbsp dill, choppedMix the flour, egg, water and a pinch of salt to a soft dough and rest it 15 minutes.Mix the mash with the cheddar and half the onion, fried soft, and season well.Roll the dough thin, cut 8cm rounds, fill and pinch shut.Boil the dumplings until they float, then fry in the butter with the rest of the onion until golden.Serve with sour cream and dill.Viktor's cracker sandwiches with hot mustardViktor lives on crackers and mustard. Salted crackers sandwiching smoked cheddar and hot mustard.How to make it24 square salted crackers150g smoked cheddar, thinly sliced3 tbsp hot English mustard2 tbsp butter, soft8 cornichons, sliced1 tbsp chives, finely choppedBeat the mustard into the soft butter.Spread half the crackers with the mustard butter and top with cheddar and cornichon.Close with the remaining crackers, pressing so the mustard just squeezes through the holes, and scatter with chives.Planters salted peanutsViktor keeps his can for something else.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsEnrique's catering truck chicken and riceEnrique trades meals for help with Dolores. Roast chicken thighs and saffron rice with green beans.How to make it8 chicken thighs, bone in, skin on2 tsp smoked paprika3 garlic cloves, crushed1 lemon, juiced2 tbsp olive oil300g long-grain rice1/4 tsp saffron threads600ml vegetable stock200g green beans, trimmed1 brown onion, dicedRub the chicken with the paprika, garlic, lemon, oil and salt.Roast skin-side up at 210°C until crisp and cooked through.While it roasts, soften the onion, stir in the rice and saffron, add the stock and simmer, covered, until tender.Steam the beans for the last 5 minutes and serve everything together, airline tray style.Luggage cart quarters cheeseburgersViktor returns luggage carts for quarters. Flame-grilled beef burgers with cheese and pickles.How to make it600g beef mince, 20 percent fat4 soft burger buns4 slices of American cheese1 white onion, thinly sliced8 dill pickle slices2 tomatoes, sliced4 iceberg lettuce leaves3 tbsp whole-egg mayonnaise2 tbsp tomato sauceShape the mince into 4 thin patties a little wider than the buns and season well.Grill over high heat 3 minutes, flip, add the cheese and cook 2 minutes more.Toast the buns and spread with mayo and tomato sauce.Build with lettuce, tomato, the patty, pickles and onion.SweetsGreat Day in Harlem New York cheesecakeViktor gets Benny Golson's autograph. Baked New York cheesecake with sour cherries.How to make it200g plain sweet biscuits, crushed80g butter, melted750g cream cheese, soft200g caster sugar3 eggs200g sour cream1 tsp vanilla extract1 lemon, zested680g jar pitted sour cherries, drained, 125ml juice kept1 tbsp cornflourMix the crumbs and butter and press into a lined 22cm springform tin.Beat the cream cheese and sugar until smooth, then beat in the eggs, sour cream, vanilla and zest.Pour over the base and bake at 150°C until just set with a wobble in the middle, then cool in the turned-off oven.Simmer the cherry juice with the cornflour until glossy, stir in the cherries and spoon over the chilled cake.DrinksStallion iced coffeeViktor tells Dolores she is a stallion. Strong cold brew over sweetened condensed milk and ice.How to make it600ml cold brew coffee4 tbsp sweetened condensed milk200ml cold milk2 cups ice1/4 tsp ground cinnamonSpoon the condensed milk into 4 tall glasses and fill with ice.Pour over the cold brew, then the milk, and dust with cinnamon.Stir at the table.Hot drip coffee by the gateFree refills for anyone stuck here.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
